title: Best Travel Iron 2026: 5 irons tested across 5 hotels on 4 fabrics
description: Rowenta DA1560, Conair Travel Smart, Sunbeam Hot 2 Trot, Hilife Steamer, Panasonic NI-W750CS — dual voltage, heat-up time, water leak risk, weight in carry-on tested.
lede: Five travel irons tested in 5 hotels across 3 countries. We measured heat-up time, weight, dual-voltage compatibility (120V/220V), and water leak risk.
methodology: Each iron tested on cotton dress shirt, polyester blouse, wool blend trousers, linen pants. Heat-up time measured from cold to ironing-ready. Dual-voltage tested in EU (220V) and US (120V) outlets.

sections.heading: Heat-up, voltage, and weight
paragraphs: Sunbeam Hot 2 Trot cordless: 30sec heat-up (fastest), 800W, dual voltage. Panasonic NI-W750CS: 60sec, 1500W cordless. Rowenta DA1560: 90sec, 1000W corded. Conair Travel Smart: 90sec, 420W folding.

Hilife handheld steamer: 25sec, no iron required (can't burn fabric). All cordless options work great if you can plan around standing time. Hilife is the only option that handles delicate silk safely.

faqs.a: Steamer (Hilife) for delicate fabrics, mid-trip touch-ups, and zero burn risk. Iron (Rowenta, Panasonic) for crisp creases in cotton shirts. Most frequent travelers use a steamer; business travelers with daily suits need an iron.

faqs.q: Do I need dual voltage for international travel?
faqs.a: Yes for Europe (220V) and Asia (varies). All 5 tested are dual voltage. Without dual voltage, a 120V US iron plugged into 220V will burn out instantly. Also need physical adapter for outlet shape.

rowenta-da1560-travel-iron.review: Best overall. 1000W dual voltage, stainless soleplate, vertical steam. Compact 1.6 lb. Perfect hotel iron.

conair-travel-smart-iron.review: Folding handle, dual voltage, 420W, water spray. 1 lb compact, comes with travel pouch. Most affordable.

sunbeam-hot-2go-iron.review: Cordless dual-voltage, ceramic soleplate, 800W. Heats in 30 sec, holds heat 5 min off-stand. Best cordless.

hilife-handheld-travel-steamer.review: 240ml water tank, ceramic plate, dual voltage, 25-sec heat-up. Won't burn fabrics. Best for silk and delicates.

panasonic-niw750cs-cordless-iron.review: Curved soleplate, cordless 1500W, dual voltage. Best build quality for frequent travelers. Heats in 60 sec.
